client_flow.overview: End-to-end model compilation and inference dispatch architecture from App layer to physical ANE coprocessor

execution_pipeline_stages.description: App requests neural graph compilation or inference through public Apple frameworks.
MIL graph is translated into ZinIr, optimized via ZinMirOpt, partitioned across clusters, scheduled via ZinCpBasedAllocator, and compiled into .hwx Hardware Executable container.
Manages model lifecycle, parses .hwx container, prepares input/output IOSurfaces, and maps shared events.
execution_pipeline_stages.dispatch_mechanism: XPC to aned system daemon via _ANEDaemonConnection, or direct kernel client via _ANEVirtualClient for privileged processes.

execution_pipeline_stages.description: System daemon enforcing sandbox policies, managing global QoS priorities, model cache eviction, and multi-tenant resource arbitration.
IOKit user client translating userland requests into kernel DMA descriptors, mapping IOSurfaces to DART IOMMU, and queuing work.
Physical MMIO register control, clock gating, MPM power domain transitions, and DART IOMMU page table programming for 3 physical ANE clusters (fANE0, fANE1, fANE2).
execution_pipeline_stages.hardware_mapping: MMIO register banks, DART translation table base registers, thermal throttling registers

execution_pipeline_stages.description: Real-time firmware running on the ANE coprocessor microcontroller, managing hardware command FIFO (Node ID 0x40, granularity 0x10), task stream decoding, and matrix execution.

kernel_to_hardware.transport: Direct MMIO Register Writes & DMA Ring Buffers
kernel_to_hardware.dma_protection: Apple DART (Device Address Resolution Table / IOMMU)
